elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires Commerce One, at Corio's request, to provide transition assistance to Corio.

elements.element: Transition assistance remains available for up to six months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 guarantees assistance only for at least 90 days; it does not require availability for six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The redline does not state any rates or other pricing for transition assistance.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) requires Commerce One to export and deliver to Corio all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Corio, its Customers, and Software Users that is in Commerce One's possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor completes the return of Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) expressly requires export and delivery within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The redline requires export and delivery but specifies no format and does not require a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor deletes remaining copies of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 contains no post-return deletion duty. Section 11.3 permits return or destruction of Confidential Information and therefore does not require deletion after data is returned.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Neither Section 11.3 nor Section 11.4 requires Commerce One to provide a deletion certification.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(a) applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires Commerce One, at Corio's request, to provide transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided for 90 days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(a) requires transition assistance for at least 90 days, satisfying the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor exports Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) requires Commerce One to export and deliver to Corio all relevant data in Commerce One's possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor completes the data export within 30 days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The redline fully reaches the fallback by providing at least 90 days of transition assistance and requiring data export and delivery within 30 days after any expiration or termination. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits six-month availability, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, post-return deletion, and deletion certification. The amendment is confined to transition assistance and data return and does not alter unrelated termination or survival terms.
